BiblicalUsage: En-Rogel is a place near Jerusalem. In Joshua 15:7, the text says "and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Rogel matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Rogel is one of them.
